The soils here in Mtwara are sandy and weak, so I must use some chemical fertilizer if I want to harvest enough maize to feed my family this year. I was able to get a small amount through the voucher program, but I will plant my own saved seed because the hybrid seed is too costly for me. My family will do all the work with hand hoes since I cannot afford to hire anyone, and I will not waste money on chemicals or irrigation when we depend on the rains.
